    "category": "Authentication",
    "title": "Authentication failures are swallowed and protected handlers continue",
    "description": "require_auth catches all exceptions, including Flask's 401 HTTPException from abort(), sets g.user to None, and still invokes the protected handler.     "evidence": "The wrapper catches Exception at lines 55-57 and unconditionally calls f(*args, **kwargs) at line 58. An unauthenticated GET /giftcards/HF123 reached the protected handler and returned its resource lookup response (404 for a nonexistent card) instead of 401; the same pattern also allowed GET /orders/1 to return order data."
